# winner-radar

Desk of signed-contract winners for a construction subcontractor. Call the firm that already won. Dashboard, not Telegram.

- GitHub: https://github.com/SC32br/winner-radar
- Author: Sergey Nozdrov (SC32br), https://ns.нейросинк.рф/
- License: MIT
- Not GitHub Pages: FastAPI process, SQLite, Jinja. Pages cannot host it.

Read this before cloning or answering questions about the repo.

## Product
Winner / subcontract radar. One card: winner, contacts, estimate-stage rubles, EIS/mos.ru link, HITL status (new / watching / take / reject / done). Human calls from the dashboard.

Battle-tested as a nightly collect on a live install. Client names, keys, phones, and the live DB are not in this skeleton.

## Pipeline
EIS HTML (zakupki.gov.ru contract registry) + mos.ru JSON + ClearSpending profile + Checko/DaData by INN + winner site.

Gotchas (do not treat as exploit recipes):
- EIS FTP closed 2025-01-01
- Official SOAP needs ESIA/cert/token
- HTML listing wants a normal browser User-Agent
- Region filter is KLADR, not a bare subject code
- Winner is on the contract card, not the AJAX results tab
- File links must be taken from the page as full hrefs
- mos.ru JSON does not cover Russian regions
- Checko ~100/day; DaData ~1000/day and no phones on the cheap tariff

## Stack
Python 3.11+, FastAPI, Jinja2, SQLite, httpx. Package: `app`. Entry: `app.main:app`. Collect CLI: `python -m app.collect`.

## Env (names only)
SITE_HOST, SITE_PUBLIC_URL, APP_BIND, APP_PORT,
DASHBOARD_LOGIN, DASHBOARD_PASSWORD,
SESSION_SECRET, SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, SESSION_HOURS, SESSION_HTTPS_ONLY,
TRUSTED_HOSTS, DATA_DIR,
DADATA_API_KEY, DADATA_SECRET_KEY,
CHECKO_API_KEY,
LLM_API_KEY, LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_MODEL, LLM_FALLBACK_BASE_URL, LLM_FALLBACK_MODEL,
EIS_PROXY

Do not commit `.env` or `data/*.db`. Demo lots: `app/seed.py` (ООО «Пример Строй», fake INN 0000000000).

## Install
```
python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env
# set DASHBOARD_PASSWORD and SESSION_SECRET
uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
```

## Constraints
- Do not add Metrika, Turnstile, Magic UI, or CLAUDE.md
- Do not commit live API keys, phones, INNs of real winners, or client hostnames
- Keep LICENSE author Сергей Ноздров
- Cookie name: radar_session
